item.title: [New] SharePoint temporary-authentication (tempauth) URLs retire on 1 April 2027; Power Apps and flows that hand out pre-authenticated SharePoint links break
item.description:
Pre-authenticated SharePoint URLs are bearer links: anyone holding one downloads the file without signing in. Their retirement closes an exfiltration path; custom connectors that depend on them will fail.

Power Platform · Inventory custom Power Platform controls, actions and connectors that return or consume SharePoint tempauth URLs and move them to Entra ID tokens before 1 April 2027.

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio agents let users create third-party service connections inside the chat, reusing an existing connection where possible; GA by 31 December 2026
item.description:
Fewer clicks between a user and a new OAuth connection to a third-party service means connector data-loss-prevention policies become the only control on what agents can reach.

Copilot Studio · Review Power Platform connector DLP policies and connection sharing for Copilot Studio environments before GA; tell owners of custom-canvas agents on the Standard harness to update their implementation.

item.description:

item.description:

Power Platform · Before 8 December review Microsoft 365 Copilot in Power BI and Fabric (availability and requirements) and decide whether default-on is acceptable; record the tenant settings that will be removed.

item.description:
Microsoft Copilot Cowork now supports Power Platform connectors managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing centralized control over connector use with third-party apps. Rollout completes by mid-November 2026. Admins should review and configure connector availability, noting that Power Platform DLP policies do not apply to Cowork.
